title: The mechanical heart
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: the storm breaking before dawn, first pale morning light behind towering clouds, sea mist, emerald threat light.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; a second barnacled mechanical crab walker, visibly much larger than the first, with heavier armour plates, brighter green conduits, huge iron claws and hissing hydraulic pistons.
Camera: over Penny's shoulder to the walker's chest; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Penny pries back a loose armour plate on the walker's arm with her wrench, revealing a glowing green receiver pulsing at the heart of the machine; she points it out urgently.
No dialogue.
Sound: metal prying, pulsing hum.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (Penny, the second Leviathan), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: The receiver pulses faster.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: metal prying, pulsing hum.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
negative_prompt: text, captions, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra limbs, duplicated characters, sudden wardrobe changes, costume swaps, graphic injury, blood, gore, still image, slideshow, freeze frame, live action humans, 2D flat animation, anime, background music
